underlyingFundsCards.description: The Fund seeks to achieve high current income by investing in a broad range of fixed income securities, while maintaining a relatively low risk profile, with a secondary goal of long-term capital appreciation.

underlyingFundsCards.name: iShares Emerging Markets Government Bond Index Fund (IE)

underlyingFundsCards.name: PIMCO GIS Emerging Markets Bond Fund SGD-Hedged
